Title: Lock All Internal Lines
Content: Lock All Internal Lines - Lock all Internal Lines to inhibit selecting and editing in the 2D window. - Right-click on the 2D window and select Lock All Internal Lines from the pop-up menu. All Internal Lines will turn grey and be deactivated. - Only activated Patterns can be selected and edited.

Title: Lock All Graphics
Content: Lock All Graphics - Lock all Graphics to inhibit selecting and editing in the 2D Window. - Right click on the 2D Window and select LOCK ALL GRAPHICS from the pop-up menu. All Graphics will be deactivated

Title: Superimpose (Under)
Content: Superimpose (Under) - When a Pattern is sewn to another Pattern, place one below the others surface based on the Sewing Lines. - Choose the Select/Move tool from the 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. - Right-click on the 3D Garment and select Superimpose (Under). - The selected Pattern will be arranged under the sewn pair along its surface. - The Superimpose (Under) function can be used only when two Patterns are sewn to each other.

Title: Superimpose (Side)
Content: Superimpose (Side) - When a Pattern is sewn to another Pattern, place one next to the others side based on the Sewing Lines. - Choose the Select/Move tool from the 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. - Right-click on the 3D Garment and select Superimpose (Side). - The selected Pattern will be arranged next to the sewn pair along its side. - The Superimpose (Side) function can be used only when two Patterns are sewn to each other.

Title: Superimpose (Over)
Content: Superimpose (Over) - When a Pattern is sewn to another Pattern, place one above the others surface based on the Sewing Lines. - Choose the Select/Move tool from the 3D toolbar and navigate to the 3D window. - Right-click on the 3D Garment and select Superimpose (Over). - The selected Pattern will be arranged above the sewn pair along its surface. - The Superimpose (Over) function can be used only when two Patterns are sewn to each other.

Title: Flip Vertically (2D)
Content: Flip Vertically (2D) - Flip a Pattern vertically in the 2D window. - Select the Transform Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. - Navigate to the 2D window and right click on the Pattern to be flipped and select Flip Vertically. - The selected Pattern will be flipped vertically.

Title: Flip Horizontally (2D)
Content: Flip Horizontally (2D) - Flip a Pattern horizontally in the 2D window. - Select the Transform Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. - Navigate to the 2D window and right click on the Pattern to be flipped and select Flip Horizontally. - The selected Pattern will be flipped horizontally.

Title: Delete Reference Line
Content: Delete Reference Line - Delete the Reference Line originally created to use as a guide when editing a Pattern. - Select the Transform Pattern tool or Edit Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. - Right-click on the Pattern and select Delete Reference Line from the pop-up menu. - The selected Patterns Reference Line will be deleted. - Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select Edit Pattern tool. Then, click and drag to move the desired point or line on the Pattern to confirm.

Title: Cut
Content: List of Contents Cut Use Cut Cut - Cut Patterns based on the Internal Line. - The CUT can be operated with following tools: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern tool Main Menu 2D Pattern Trace tool Use Cut - Navigate to and select following tools: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern tool Trace tool - Right-click on the Internal Line and select Cut from the pop-up menu. - The Pattern will cut based on the Internal Line.

Title: Cut & Sew
Content: List of Contents Cut&ampSew Use Cut&ampSew Cut&ampSew - Cut and sew Patterns at once based on the Internal Line. - The Cut &amp Sew can be operated with following tools: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern tool Main Menu 2D Pattern Trace tool Use Cut&ampSew - Navigate to and select following tools: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern tool Main Menu 2D Pattern Trace tool - Right-click on the Internal Line and select Cut &amp Sew from the pop-up menu. - The Pattern will cut and sewn based on the Internal Line.

Title: Convert to Curve Point
Content: Convert to Curve Point - Convert a segment point to a curve point. - Select the Edit Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. - Navigate to the 2D window, right click on a segment point to be converted and select Convert to Curve Point. - The selected segment point will be converted to a curve point.

Title: Video Capture - Turn Table
Content: List of Contents Turn Table Video Capture Record Turn Table Video Edit Turn Table Video Save Turn Table Video Turn Table Video Capture - Record the 3D Garment in CLO to share with others for efficient communication. - Navigate to the Main Menu and select File Video Capture Turn Table. Record Turn Table Video - Navigate to the Main Menu and select File Video Capture Turn Table. - The Turn Table Video Capture window will appear on the bottom of the window. - Modify the options under the Video Size, Options, and the Video Codec sections. - After adjusting the options as needed, select the Record button. - When the recording is done, the preview window will appear. Edit Turn Table Video - Edit the recording in the preview window. - Split the video by right-clicking and selecting the Split option on the timeline bar. - Then, select the timeline to be deleted and right click and select the Delete option. Save Turn Table Video - Select the Save button to save the edited recording. - Assign the saving path and the file name and click Save. - The recording will be saved.

Title: Project File Open/Save
Content: List of Contents Project File Open Project File Overwrite Project File Save Project File Project File - Save or open a file with 3D Garment, 3D Environment Settings (background, lighting, wind, camera, Simulation) animation information and more. Open Project File - Navigate to and select File Open Project - The Open File Window will appear. - Locate the file and select Open. Overwrite Project File - A project file can be overwritten when a project file is already open. - Navigate to and select File Save Project. - The opened project file will be overwritten. Save Project File - Navigate to and select File Save As Project. - Designate the saving path and select Save.

Title: 3D File (LXO) Export
Content: Objective Export garments and avatars as LXO file format which is compatible with Modo. The LXO file format includes Geometry and Material information. Location Main Menu File Export LXO Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Export LXO The Save File window appears. Designate the file saving path and the file name. Then, select Save. The file is exported as a LXO file format.

Title: BOM(XML) Export
Content: Objective Export all information associated with the 3D Garment in text (XML) and image (PNG) formats. BOM (XML) + ZPRJ + Images (Colorway, 2D Pattern, 3D Garment, Avatar, Button, Fabric, Print Layout, Puckering, Topstitch) are exported. Location Main Menu File Export BOM (XML) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Export BOM (XML) Enter a file name and navigate to the desired path, then click Save. The XML + ZPRJ + Images (Colorway, 2D Pattern, 3D Garment, Avatar, Button, Fabric, Print Layout, Puckering, Topstitch) information is saved.

Title: Animation Import
Content: Objective Import Animation cache data created in the third-party 3D solutions. Note: Refer to the links below for FBX/ Alembic file import:. 3D File (FBX) Import/Export 3D File (Alembic) Import/Export Location Main Menu File Import Animation Maya Cache(.mc) Maya Cache(.mcx) Point Cache 2 MDD Cache(Standard) MDD Cache(Maya/3ds Max) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Import Animation Maya Cache(.mc) Maya Cache(.mcx) Point Cache 2 MDD Cache(Standard) MDD Cache(Maya/3ds Max) The File Explorer or Find window appears. Select the desired file and click OK. An option window appears with settings that apply to the file format selected. Set the following individual settings. Object Select All Avatars Apply the cache data to all objects in the 3D environment. Cache data can be applied to individual objects from the submenu. FPS Set the frame rate of the cache data. Note: This menu only appears when importing Point Cache (PC2) files. Scale Set the scale of the cache data. Axis Conversion Set the axis direction for the cache data. The Y-axis runs vertically by default. Garment Position Move Avatar &amp Garment to Start Position Moves the Avatar and Garment to the location of the first frame (ver2.5.0). Transition Animation A transition animation is an animation that changes from a T-pose to a motions first pose in stages, and is created when the avatars current pose and motion differs from that of the first frame pose. Click OK. The cache data is imported according to the selected settings.

Title: Scene Time Warp
Content: Objective Adjust speed of Animation frames (ver2.5.0). Location Animation Mode Animation Editor Scene Time Warp Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Animation Mode Animation Editor Scene Time Warp Enter desired value and press Enter on the keyboard. Frame rate for all Garment/Avatar Animation in the Animation Editor is now being adjusted according to the entered value.

Title: Delete Animation
Content: Objective Delete loaded Avatar Motion files or recorded Garment Animations. Location Animation Mode Animation Editor Animation Right-click Menu Delete Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Animation Mode Animation Editor Animation Right-click Menu Delete The selected Animation is now being deleted. Note: Deleted Animation frames cannot be restored by 'Undo'.

Title: Select Seam Allowance
Content: Objective Select seam allowances on Pattern outlines. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Seam Allowance 2D Toolbar Seam Allowance Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Seam Allowance 2D Toolbar Seam Allowance Click the Pattern outline where the seam allowance is on. The seam allowance is selected and its Pattern outline is highlighted in yellow.

Title: Morph Target with AVT Files
Content: Objective Apply morph target function onto the AVT files to change the avatar Pose or shape. Location Main Menu File Open Avatar Main Menu File Add Avatar Operation Open an Avatar in the 3D window. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu File Open Avatar Main Menu File Add Avatar The Add Avatar or Open Avatar window appears. Select Load as Morph Target for the Load Type and select OK. If morphing succeeds, the first avatar Pose or shape changes to the second avatar Pose or shape. If morphing fails, a warning pop-up window appears and no change is made.

Title: Change Pose by Collada's Joint Information
Content: Objective Note: Only available for file formats with avatar joint information. In this case, COLLADA is being used. As avatar's joints move as the pose changes, it is able to change avatar pose while keeping the stimulation stably even if there is a large difference between the starting and the end poses. However if the avatar is formatted via DAZ Studio, some composition form information may be lost during the process. Therefore there is a need to load the posed avatar's OBJ file and adjust garments after changing the pose. (The avatar's OBJ file only saves the composition form information, there is no danger of losses in the loading process.) Operation Export a T-pose avatar which can be easily draped and an avatar with the final pose in COLLADA files. To find out export methods from DAZ Studio and Poser in details, check 3D File (COLLADA) Import for the reference. After exporting the COLLADA files, export the avatar poses in OBJ files. Load a posed COLLADA file from the previously saved avatars in CLO 3D/MD. Click File Save Pose to save current avatar as POS file. After dressing T-pose avatar, this file is going to be used when changing current pose. Click File Open Avatar to open the previously saved T-pose COLLADA file. Dress the avatar with desired garments. Now Click File Open Pose to open the previously saved POS file. The avatar slowly changes poses. It may take a while depending on the complexity of the garments. After the pose changes, load an OBJ file without any loss and adjust garments. Click File Import OBJ to open the previously saved final pose OBJ file. Highly positive to observe garments being under the avatar's surface. While simulation is being activated, drag out the parts that are gone under the avatar's surface by using left mouse button. To find more details in Select/Move tool, check Move Garment for the reference.

Title: Reset Joints
Content: Objective Reset avatar's joints back to before editing (ver2.3.0). Location 3D Window Right-click Pop-up Menu (On Avatar) Reset Joints Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Window Right-click Pop-up Menu (On Avatar) Reset Joints Avatar's joints reset.

Title: Zoom Extents All (2D)
Content: Objective Set the view in the 2D window to reveal all patterns or center the 2D view to the center of the 2D grid. Location Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Zoom Extents All Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Zoom Extents All The 2D view is adjusted to reveal all existing 2D Patterns, if any, or resets the view to the center of the 2D window.

Title: Delete Seam Allowance
Content: Objective Delete unnecessary seam allowances. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Seam Allowance 2D Toolbar Seam Allowance Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Seam Allowance 2D Toolbar Seam Allowance Click Pattern outline where the seam allowance is on. The seam allowance is selected and the Pattern outline is highlighted in yellow. Hit the Delete key on the keyboard. The selected seam allowance is deleted. Or, right click on the Pattern outline where the seam allowance is on. Right-click pop-up menu appears. Select Delete. The selected seam allowance is deleted.

Title: Flip Horizontally/Vertically
Content: Objective Flip Patterns/Internal Shapes horizontally or vertically as needed. Location Main Menu Edit Context Menu 2D Pattern Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically (ver2.5.0) Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Pattern Transform tool or the Edit Pattern tool. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Edit Context Menu 2D Pattern Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically (ver2.5.0) Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically The selected Patterns/ Internal Shapes are flipped horizontally or vertically.

Title: Order
Content: Objective When you create Patterns in the 2D window, the last Pattern created is placed on the front by default. Change the order of the Patterns as needed. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Order Bring Forward / Bring to Front / Send Backward / Send to Back Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Patterntool. Select the Pattern or Internal Line or Shape to be reordered. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Order Bring Forward / Bring to Front / Send Backward / Send to Back The selected object is reordered.

Title: Open/Save Bounding Volume
Content: Objective Save newly created Bounding Volume, open and use previously saved Arrangement Points. Location Main Menu Avatar Avatar Editor Arrangement Bounding Volume Open / Save Operation Open Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Avatar Avatar Editor Arrangement Bounding Volume Open Open File window appears. Select desired file and click Open to load. Save Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Avatar Avatar Editor Arrangement Bounding Volume Save Save File window appears. Select desired location to store. Enter desired file name and click Save. A .pan file is now being created.

Title: Superimpose
Content: Objective Arrange a newly sewn Pattern onto its corresponding Pattern. This function is helpful when arranging facings, linings, cuffs, collars and other pieces where they need to be arranged directly laying on another. Location 3D Toolbar Select/Move 3D Pattern Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Superimpose (Over) / Superimpose (Under) / Superimpose (Side) Operation Utilizing the 2D sewing tools, sew a new Pattern to an existing Pattern that is being draped. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Select/Move 3D Pattern Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Superimpose (Over) / Superimpose (Under) / Superimpose (Side) The selected Pattern is now being arranged accordingly. Note: This function only applies to Patterns that are already being sewn together.

Title: Zoom Extents All (3D)
Content: Objective Set the view in the 3D window to reveal all Patterns or center the 3D view to the center of the 3D grid. Location Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Zoom Extents All Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Zoom Extents All The 3D view is adjusted to reveal all 3D Patterns, or resets the view to the center of the 3D grid.

Title: Physical Property Detail Setting
Content: Adjust each item of the detailed settings to express Physical Properties not included in Presets. Each property mutually affects one another and a Garment's physical property is expressed by combination of all detailed property values. Note: The property details are adjustable with the scroll bar or by entering in actual measurement values. Scroll Bar [0~99]: This is better input method when the constant value is far too enormous. To reduce this inconvenience, the most commonly used Physical Property is split into 99 stages. Constant Value [0~1000000000] This is better input method when setting far more accurate Physical Properties than the scroll bar method above.
